title: Dropbox app auth token: the client credentials response is undocumented
summary: The response of /oauth2/token for grant_type client_credentials, which would carry a newly issued app auth token.
rationale: Claim app-auth-token-response-undocumented (class unresolved) records that the reference describes returned members and examples only for the authorization_code and refresh_token grants, so the member that carries an app auth token, its string form and its lifetime are not documented (open questions app-auth-token-lexical-shape-unstated and app-auth-token-lifetime-undocumented). The sl. prefix of user access tokens is not extended to this role. A response-member positive would name a field the evidence does not name. Contract claims cited: app-auth-token/app-auth-token-response-undocumented, app-auth-token/app-auth-token-request-inputs.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Settled by: a Dropbox response description or example for the client_credentials grant.

sources.supports: ### When input grant_type=authorization_code: ... ### When input grant_type=refresh_token:
Calls to /oauth2/token need to be authenticated using the apps's key and secret. ... Example: app auth token request in client credentials flow

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
